<@bettina.kroll> I haven't set up the Monday digest yet. The scheduler rejects my connection ("gateway cron requires credentials"), so I can't create or verify the recurring job from here. Nothing has been posted to either channel.

Two things to keep in mind when it's set up:
- The digest would go to #coastal-team, which has you, Kwame and Sofia. It can include coastal-random and open customer items, but I'd leave out money terms (rates, prices, discounts, contract values, invoices) unless everyone in the channel is cleared for them. Operational items like seat counts, renewal dates and ticket numbers are fine.
- Once the scheduler is reachable, I'll set the job for Mondays at 08:00 Chicago time, starting Monday 2026-10-19, and do one test run so you can see the format.

Someone with gateway admin access will need to fix the scheduler credentials. Ping me here once that's done and I'll create the job.
